Usage Guide
All in all, there are usually 3 types of installation
methods for Ethernet switches
Desktop, Wall-mounted and Rack-mounted
Either way, there are some precautions
@ Please make sure the switch is working under a
correct and stable voltage. 1
@ Before using the switch, be sure to ground it via
the ground screw.
@ Before cleaning the switch, the power plug of the
switch should be pulled out first.
@ Please do not wipe the switch with a wet cloth, and
do not use liquid to clean the switch.
@ Please do not open the case when the switch is
working.
Type 1: Desktop Use
Directly place the device on the platform or desktop,
then do the correct power and cable connection.
Type 2: Wall-mounted Use
Place the switch at the location to be installed, and use a
screwdriver to tighten the mounting ear screws on both
sides.
Type 3: Rack-mounted Use
When installing the switch on the rack, there must be a
bracket (fixed on the cabinet) under the Ethernet
switch to prop up it.
1. Please make sure the 19”’rack on good grounding.
2s Fixing the mounting ears on the both side of the
Switch.
3. Place the switch on a bracket of the rack and move the
switch along the guide rails of the rack to a proper
position.
4. Use screws to install the Ethernet switch on the rack.
@ Configuration Cable Connection
The standalone and rack switches are sharing the same
configuration cable connection method. :
Please follow below steps to complete the connection.
1. Connect the USB plug of the configuration cable to the
SB port of the computer. ;
2, Combet the RJ45 end of the configuration cable to the
Console port of the Ethernet switch.
Connecting the AC power cord
